'''Kagan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Trained in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], as part of her final trial Kagan was sent by [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Harkun]] into the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] to retrieve the helm of [[Tulak Hord]] along with a group of other acolytes, which included [[Greck (acolyte)|Greck]], [[Bensyn]] and [[Lana Beniko]]. Upon entering the [[Tomb of Tulak Hord]] the group was overwhelmed by [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slugs]], which left Greck dead and Kagan severely wounded. Beniko eventually found Tulak Hord’s helmet among the rubble, but before they could leave, Kagan was killed by an insane [[Unidentified Zabrak acolyte|Zabrak acolyte]].
